name: Strix
description: Security testing and remediation for authorized applications.

questions.question: What should it test?
questions.note: The practice app is deliberately vulnerable and runs inside the VM, so it is safe to try.

choices.label: A practice app inside the VM
choices.note: a deliberately vulnerable app Yougori starts inside the VM, safe to try

choices.label: A website or address I give
choices.note: http(s) URLs, host:port or IPv4 addresses, separated by commas

questions.question: Do you own this target or have written permission to test it?
questions.note: Testing a system without its owner's permission is illegal in most places.
questions.refusal: Yougori tests only targets you own or have written permission to test. Nothing was started.

questions.question: What is off limits?
questions.note: Paths or hosts it must not touch, separated by commas.

choices.label: Look only
choices.note: maps the target and reads its pages; sends no attacks

choices.label: Test safely
choices.note: tries attacks that change and break nothing

choices.label: Full exploitation
choices.note: exploits what it finds to prove it; may change data

questions.question: Login for the test?
questions.note: A test account's user name or email, to test behind the sign-in.

questions.question: Password for that login?
questions.note: It never goes into files, logs or the report.

questions.question: Source code?
questions.note: A copy goes into the VM as its workspace, so the test can read the code.

questions.question: Focus?
questions.note: What matters most.
